<!--
Do not include secrets, private Discord material, leaked/intimate media, private
identities, home addresses, private contact details, or access-bearing URLs.
-->

## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Contribution type

- [ ] Homepage, navigation, or interface
- [ ] Wiki correction or new topic
- [ ] Public source citation or image provenance
- [ ] Build, tooling, or documentation

## Public sources for wiki changes

List the exact public URL and timestamp, post, page, or archive locator for each
material claim. Explain any dispute, corroboration, or source limitation. Write
`Not applicable` for changes that make no factual wiki claim.

## Visual verification

Add screenshots or a short description of desktop/mobile testing when the rendered
site changes. Do not include private or sensitive source material.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] This pull request is focused and contains no secrets or private material.
- [ ] Public links work and use accurate labels.
- [ ] Wiki claims follow `EDITORIAL_POLICY.md` and give precise public citations.
- [ ] New images have adjacent source, rights, and transformation information.
- [ ] No raw snapshots, transcripts, private research, or access-controlled media are included.
- [ ] I ran `npm run build` successfully.
- [ ] I checked relevant desktop/mobile, keyboard, and reduced-motion behavior.
